working_geometry_plain: The working L8 geometry is a finite gluing/groupoid/equivariant dynamic candidate carried by PEPS3D spinor-density anchors. PEPS3D sites are finite objects, PEPS3D edges generate arrows with identities and inverses, transition channels are finite torch unitary channels, and local dynamics is checked for transition covariance. A noncommuting plaquette order witness remains visible while abelian/order-erased controls collapse. This is still a local finite candidate layer, not stacked manifold closure, flux, Axis0, physics, or final manifold evidence.
